fields.description: Issue features continued investigative coverage of Jose Aleman and related federal immigration correspondence, including a letter from the U.S. Department of Justice, Immigration and Naturalization Service disputing prior reporting. Reports on alleged police brutality cases and upcoming hearings, Miami city commission election candidate statements and polling, and commentary on national business practices focusing on A. & P. advertising and alleged fraud. Additional items address juvenile use of falsified draft cards and drivers’ licenses to obtain alcohol, traffic safety messaging, and local utility/telephone rate and directory advertising disputes, alongside regular columns and advertisements.
